newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee slips at close in kerb, seen down.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee slipped 0.12 to 41.30 to the dollar at Wednesday's close amid a high demand for the U.S. currency and dealers said they expected the rupee to remain under pressure in the coming days.
"The dollar demand was high and its supply was short," one dealer said. "In the international market, the dollar gained against most currencies."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.70 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
